segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Hello, Tourist Information Centre, Mike speaking, how can I help you?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, hi. I wanted to find out about cookery classes. I believe there are some one-day classes for tourists?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, they’re open to everyone, but tourists are always welcome. OK, let me give you some details of what’s available. There are several classes. One very popular one is at the Food Studio.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: They focus on seasonal products, and as well as teaching you how to cook them, they also show you how to choose them.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, that sounds good. How big are the classes?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: I’m not sure exactly, but they’ll be quite small.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And could I get a private lesson there?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: I think so ... let me check, yes, they do offer those. Though in fact most of the people who attend the classes find it’s a nice way of getting to know one another.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: I suppose it must be, yes.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: And this company has a special deal for clients where they offer a discount of 20 percent if you return for a further class.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK. But you said there were several classes?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: That’s right. Another one you might be interested in is Bond’s Cookery School. They’re quite new, they just opened six months ago, but I’ve heard good things about them. They concentrate on teaching you to prepare healthy food, and they have quite a lot of specialist staff.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: So is that food for people on a diet and things like that? I don’t know if I’d be interested in that.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, I don’t think they particularly focus on low calorie diets or weight loss. It’s more to do with recipes that look at specific needs, like including ingredients that will help build up your bones and make them stronger, that sort of thing.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: I see. Well, I might be interested, I’m not sure. Do they have a website I could check?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Yes, just key in the name of the school – it’ll come up. And if you want to know more about them, every Thursday evening they have a lecture at the school. It’s free and you don’t need to book or anything, just turn up at 7.30. And that might give you an idea of whether you want to go to an actual class. —————————

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: OK, there’s one more place you might be interested in. That’s got a rather strange name, it’s called The Arretsa Centre – that’s spelled A-R-R-E-T-S-A.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: They’ve got a very good reputation. They do a bit of meat and fish cookery but they mostly specialise in vegetarian dishes.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. That’s certainly an area I’d like to learn more about. I’ve got lots of friends who don’t eat meat. In fact, I think I might have seen that school today. Is it just by the market?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: That’s right. So they don’t have any problem getting their ingredients. They’re right next door. And they also offer a special two-hour course in how to use a knife. They cover all the different skills – buying them, sharpening, chopping techniques. It gets booked up quickly though so you’d need to check it was available.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, well thank you very much. I’ll go and ...
